Use English or Simplified Chinese. 可以使用英文或简体中文。

## Expected and observed behavior / 预期与实际行为

## Minimal steps to reproduce / 最小复现步骤

## Environment / 环境

- Project commit or version / 项目提交或版本
- Windows, Python, and GPU / Windows、Python 和显卡
- Game build, SHA-256, difficulty, shot type, and stage / 游戏版本、SHA-256、难度、自机和关卡
- Session mode and compute backend / 会话模式和计算后端

## Evidence / 证据

Include the full reason or stack trace and any relevant action or death IDs. For performance issues, give the measurement endpoints, sample count, and P50/P95/P99. Sanitize logs and share the smallest relevant extract.

请附完整原因或异常栈，以及相关动作或死亡编号。性能问题请注明计时起止点、样本数和 P50/P95/P99。请先脱敏，只分享相关片段。

Keep game files, checkpoints, console tokens, full run folders, and dependency directories private.

请勿上传游戏文件、模型、控制令牌、完整运行目录或依赖目录。
